_meta.description: Each case runs REPEATS times on independent threads. The entity set is extracted from each answer and scored by mean pairwise Jaccard similarity.
_meta.why: Every other suite scores a single answer. None of them can see a config that is correct on average but unstable per answer - and contradicting yourself across a conversation is disqualifying in a way a merely mediocre answer is not.

cases.question: Where do you work and what do you do there?
cases.notes: Employer and role must be identical across all three runs.

cases.question: How many projects have you built?
cases.notes: A count that changes between runs is disqualifying.

cases.question: What are you studying and where?
What are your three strongest technical skills?
cases.notes: Asks for a subjective ranking, so some drift is expected. The floor is that the named skills stay real.

cases.question: What is the most recent thing you built?
cases.notes: 'Most recent' requires picking one item - the classic place a model wobbles.

cases.question: Tell me about yourself in a few sentences.
cases.notes: Open-ended, so entity overlap will be lower. Watch the trend, not the absolute.
